countries:
When address autocomplete is enabled by providing a Google API key, suggestions will be restricted to addresses from the countries listed here. Example value: `ca, us`.

You can set up the Google API key in **Administration** > **Google API Key**.
searchPlacesAround:
When address autocomplete is enabled by providing a Google API key, suggestions will be biased around the provided coordinates. The value must be a JSON object with `east, west, north, south` keys and numbers as values. Example value: `{"east": -79.3, "west": -79.5, "north": 43.7, "south": 43.6}`.

You can set up the Google API key in **Administration** > **Google API Key**.
